review_description: Installation was ok but getting the system online was difficult and took around 6 months from installation to generating solar energy, with nobody really knowing what was going on. Terrible after sales support, the first inverter failed after a year and I was basically told to sort it out myself. They did act quickly once the inverter was diagnosed as faulty but it was too little too late by that stage.

Can't say for sure yet, digital meter is not yet fitted, but the system seems to be covering what we use MOST days*, and I've seen the old meter turning backwards slowly at times too.Following going with the quote, the system was installed within 2 weeks, and took 1-1/2 days, s good team.There are 11.2kw of solar panels (x27) with SolarEdge optimisers.I have had trouble getting return calls with some questions re *pre smart meter behaviour of the system, but I would expect solar companies to be very busy right now pre end of year (it just bugs me a bit with the lack of a return call).Anyway, thanks for the great site, youtube channel, blog, and quotes from your recommended installers, your info has helped guide me to the best option for us I feel.

I got a Solahart SunCell system with a GoodWe inverter installed 12 months ago. The sales process was great and the salesperson actually listened to what I wanted out of my system and made some great recommendations that I hadn't thought of, nor mentioned from others.The scheduling of the installation took more back-and-forth calls than I'd hoped but we got it installed in a reasonable timeframe.The best part is the quality of the installation. Everything was installed with care and a very neat quality installation with the installer making some tweaks on the day to ensure a quality install.Overall I highly recommend them
The process from start to finish was great, we had our system installed after only a fortnight and have got great value for money!

Very bad customer service. After you sign contract for solar all you do is chase them for information. Sloppy work by office personnel organising things. Conflicting stories between salesmen, office staff and installers. I thought I would buy local, big mistake.

From first phone call from Adelaide Solar systems and a visit from the sales representative, was really friendly helpful and informative. The sales person followed up right until after completion.The installation went really smooth. The installers were really friendly, polite, informative and very efficient.Cannot fault the customer service at all.The whole process from start to finish was a really good experience.
It was an easy process from start to finish, no money was outlaid and the installation was fantasitc.

I chose this organisation because they seemed very knowledgeable, gave great advice and were not pushy at all. They were not the cheapest or the most expensive quote I had, but seemed the most reliable, based on my impression, plus reading a lot of reviews and they seem like they will be around for a while. I bought the best panels I could afford (sunpower), thinking of upgrading with a better inverter and battery when it dies.I ended up getting it installed a couple of months earlier than expected because of someone else cancelling. I am really happy with the system so far, and have found their service and communications overall to be really good. I had an issue with connecting the SMA to wifi and they quickly arranged a site visit to help me find a solution, rather than just telling me to google, which is sort of what I expected!Highly recommend

Very impressed with professionalism of sales staff, admin staff and installation contractors. The approvals and installation time frame was fast, without stress, well communicated and extremely efficient.

I was contacted by the company after the sales person had visited my house, they informed me that the installation would start at 8.30am on 20th July, I waited in until 9.30am and then rang the company to be told that no installation had been booked for me and the installers were at another job. My job was then booked for 27th July and was commenced at that date, it took two days due to bad weather. After the installation was completed I was given an instruction sheet about connecting the Inverter Wifi to my computer, I have not been able to do this and sent an email to the company in Germany including a photo of the label of the Inverter, I was told that they would deal with it within ten days, it is now 22 days since I sent that email and I have heard nothing. Not happy Jan!
Informed and responsive staff and the whole job was done quickly and efficiently.
It was a simple job - invertor replacement. Everything went smoothly.

Adelaide Solar Systems were the only company to want to view the site before installation.Evidently if your switch board is asbestos,ETSA will not have any thing to do with it and you will have to make another booking.Their deposit prior to installation was more than reasonable and no question was considered unnecessary.
Very pleased with the service and efficiency. A good experience overall.

Brilliant company to deal with ! Prompt competitive quote tailor made to my specific needs, accurant energy projections,  and installations efficient beyond my expectations.....now receiving credits instead of bills. Cannot fault this company

We haven't had the meter changed over yet, so can't tell how well the system will work, however, the salesman was an ex-installer so knew his stuff, (we have raked ceilings and other issues that made the quotation tricky) he spent lots of time talking over the options with us, and the installers were great.  They took a lot of care to make sure that we were happy with the result, and even replaced some broken tiles which I knew were broken before they went on the roof. They had to come twice due to our roof issues, and they arrived on time both days. They were very professional and courteous to deal with, and we have had a follow up call to make sure everything is ok.  I would be happy to recommend them to anyone considering tackling this process.
We had delays with the installer submitting their paperwork which led to delays and confusion with billing from the energy company.

We had our system installed by Adelaide Solar Systems because they were recommended by two other people who had used this company and expressed great satisfaction with the service. They gave us firm dates for the installation and  kept to them. The installation team were quick efficient and very approachable

I do not know enough about Solar Systems to rate the Quality of the System or Value for money. I would have preferred to pay LESS but, I believe I have better panels. I trusted Solahart completely and, coupled with the little knowledge gained from your website, I think my installation is very good.

We have been very pleased with our entire experience with Adelaide Solar Systems. There was no hi-pressure sales from Darren who provided a free quotation. He gave us a couple of options that would suit our needs and left us to decide what we wanted to do and get back to him. The other companies we spoke to only wanted to quote on their standard systems and some wanted a fee to come and provide an accurate quotation. Being a nonstandard system on a garage roof required some additional work by the installers but this was handelded very professionally. We now have a very good 2.75kW system which was the maximum that could be fitted in the available space.Graham & Lyn
We had very helpful, efficient, courteous & punctual dealings with this Company their staff and subcontractors.Thoroughly recommended, would use their services again.
Installation 2 weeks after order and done very well despite difficult weather conditions.Installation team were first class.System is running beautifully.Very pleased with the outcome.
Very easy to deal with.  Good value for money - a quality system at a competitive price. Brilliant installers who achieved an excellent result in trying conditions.
Panels 3.27 kW Inverter 5 kW. Only just installed.   Will be Switched on middle July. Can't rate yet - too early.House extension later will allow for more panels on roof to make up 5 kW.

The Rep who called was excellent and actually got onto the roof to measure it and then gave us options on what they could supply. Also went into more detail on the panel efficiency and quality of inverters. That and not their pushy sales pitch some of the others came up with.

After a few initial communication issues, we have now had our system installed and it is fully operational. The installers, Warren and Peter went out of their way to ensure a 1st class installation on what turned out to be a difficult install due to weather conditions on the day & minimal access in the ceiling space. I even suggested a couple of shortcuts but Warren refused as he did not wish to compromise the install quality. They worked from morning until dark on a day when rain showers persisted, but none the less they completed the job in one day.The salesman Bill visited a few days later to ensure everything was OK and to answer a few questions I had for him.Thanks Guys! A great job.
Andy Turner from Adelaide Solar had a terrific knowledge of solar systems. Placement of panels. Back up of service if required. Installers were professional. Can't say enough of product and service.

Our system has not yet been installed but I am not happy with the service to date. Since contacting them a month or so ago and accepting their quote, the only contact that has occurred has been on my instigation. I know there is a delay on the meter install but they need to keep us up to date with the progress.

I did initially receive 3 phone calls in response to your website.  The first 2 phone calls I received had very poor English never got back to me with a quote.I had even emailed them our shed plan where the panels were to be installed. The third person I spoke to was so pushy, obnoxious and condescending, who  more or less forced me to have an appointment where he would assess our needs over approximately 2 hours, (the shed was not yet installed, and our home was a building site) that I cancelled the appointment the next day as there was no way I would deal with a pushy salesman he was from the Mark Group) and I had already done extensive research.The panels face direct north and there are no obstructions and never will be however his aim was to baffle us with bullshit I presume.  The initial call went for 25 minutes, in which he blew his and his companies trumpet - totally nauseating.So, I went back to the drawing board, and purchased a 5 kW system from Adelaide Solar Systems who are local, have very good feedback on all internet forums, and promptly supplied me with a quote and further information without hassle.So whilst getting the quotes via you was a waste of time, the information on your site contributed to our choice.

Bill was fantastic.  His explanations were thorough yet clear and understandable.  He turned up on time when he said he would.  He emailled through lots of spreadsheets and information for us to review in deciding which size system to go for.\r\nThey turned up when they said they would to install the system and it has worked fine.  They did everything they said they would exactly when they said.  So no time wasted sitting around waiting for tradespeople or salespeople to turn up.

There now seems to be a host of other offers for systems that on the face of it would seem cheaper than what we purchased. However we may not be comparing apples with apples.Also used the Govt. green loan to help finance purchase

I had a bad experience with Melbourne firm so I changed to Adelaide LOVE ENERGY. NOT the cheapest but really good service and installation. The installers are employees of the firm and not subcontractors.

They were not the cheapest, but everyone that referred me to them raved about the quality of the system and install. We have had the system for a week now and are delighted with the results. They were professional and great to deal with.

Obviously, since the system is not yet installed, we cannot yet judge the quality. Nevertheless, the salesperson (Bill Eckermann) made every attempt to inform and explain as objectively and comprehensively as we were hoping for.

I had three quotes of variable costs. I chose Adelaide because the salesman had at least the decency to get up on the roof and gauge the amount of shadow I could expect during winter. He was forthright and didn't try to blind me with figures. There were cheaper offers in the papers, but I feel confident that Adelaide will provide the goods,
The system has not been installed as yet so I could not amswer last three questions.
Installer turned up on time and installation went smoothly.

I found Adelaide Solar Systems provided excellent customer service. This was very important to me as the all transactions were completed, including the required forms etc., while I was working in Afghanistan. They provided answers and information and went the extra yards to provide me with an excellent system.So top marks to Adelaide Solar Systems and Solar quotes who started me off on the right path. Well done and I would have no hesitation recommending both firms to anyone.
rather than have a little we may as well try to be self sufficient hence 24-1.8 unit solar panels .staff were extremely helpfull,highly recomended.

We had five quotes but found Adelaide Solar explained every question asked, and being an Electrician myself I knew what they were telling me was what I expected to hear.  It took ten weeks from beginning to end.  Everything occurred exactly as they said it would and within the time frame advised.  I could not have asked for any better service.  At this stage we haven't had rain, so I don't know whether it may leak, but my experience so far has been excellent.  I would have no hesitation in recommending Adelaide Solar.
Disappointed that the quoted 3 months waiting period immediately blew out by a month after deposit paid.
We have our system installed but as yet not hooked up to the grid

It`s such a big decision, we got 4 quotes and decided to go with Adelaide Solar. They were not the cheapest quote we received but offered a quality product and good service. A few friends have already gone with Adelaide Solar and all have been very happy with service, product and reduction or elimination of electricity bills. We soon hope to have a BIG reduction in our electricity bill...our panels are due to be installed this week!!

2 of the 3 companies responded and provided reasonable quotes. I sourced 2 others independently, one of which was a complete rip off  (Ecoplus)- don't even bother as they try the good old fasioned high pressure sales tactic, and try to baffle you with the sales pitch.The other was successful (Adelaide Solar Systems), their pricing was mid range. However, I felt more comfortable they would be around for the long term in case of warranty issues. Also the many favourable responses received by them on this website was a determining factor. The installation took place ~3 weeks  from deposit being paid and the installation guys were very good and efficient. I would highly recommend them.

I have been looking at a 8-10KW system for some time . By doing research on panels and inverters finally went with Adelaide Solar systemsThey may not of been the cheapest price but they were very competitive. Buy expensive cry once, buy cheap and cry every day. The  components - 250 Watt C Sun Solar panels and SMA 10,000 inverter were the best quality. I liked the fact they have there own installers and guarantee their work. The installers were very friendly and professional.Overall I can thouroughly recommend Adelaide Solar Systems

The salesman who visited was also the installer - his extensive experience and helpful manner instilled in me a great deal of confidence in the company. He also got on the roof (only one other company did this) to check out the best options.

I chose Solar Electrical for 2 main reasons.  Firstly, Daniel was both installer and salesman and he was the only sales person to look at the roof properly and work out the best positioning for the panels with relation to shade etc.  And, secondly, he had a good maintenance plan.  Moreover, the service was excellent.  I was leaving the country 3 weeks after getting a quote from him and he managed to fit me into a vacancy and it was all done and running before I left.

The salesperson was spot on with all our queries. One of the other salesperson didn't have correct prices on brochure and another had to be told from when the sun rises.Very pleased with speed of installation.
Solar Wholesalers took a long time to contact me. Then told me they would ring later to organise a time for a quote. They did not ring back and to this day I have not heard from them.

Adelaide Solar Systems where not one of the companys that where giving to me by Solar quotes but after reading the reviews for Adelaide Solar Systems on this site I choose this company because, the staff where very helpful and most of all not just salesmen trying to sell you a product that they think you know nothing about.There where also the only company that priced me for what i wanted at the best price, where as one of the other companys which was chosen by solar quotes quoted me on a system, then told me that they could not guarantee that the same panels would be used (190w down to 175w panels for same price) without telling me until install NOT GOOD.The other two companys could not give me what i wanted or only parts of.

The supplier was consistently informative and helpful. We had an on-site conference, when he gave us as much time and information as we requested. This was very good, as we knew very little to start with. He also inspected the site, answering other questions. Before and after the consultation, he was very helpful with clear answers to our phone calls and emails. There was absolutely no 'hard sell'.The written quote included a very detailed specifications list. We showed this to a specialist electrician friend who is, himself, considering branching into solar installing. Our friend was able to confirm the reliability of all details of the quote, and was impressed by the helpful documentation. So were we. This, and possibly the fact that the supplier himself has had much hands-on experience, influenced our decision. It was close, as we were also very happy with one of the other suppliers. The third one seemed good, but there were some factors that were probably okay, but a bit harder to verify - e.g. some supposedly excellent components that were new to the market.Our system installation should take place within a few weeks. [We'd been told about the delay.] We're looking forward to it, and hope that all will go well. If you'd like to contact us, we'd be happy to comment on this too, when it happens.

My system has not yet been installed. So I can not say much about the Service. So far the dealing with the representative who visited my home has been very good.As for choosing Adelaide Solar System:This Company has been around for a number of years and known as Solahart and I Trust that it will be around for many more years.Finally, thank you for providing me with the names of thr three Solar Installers.
After a lot of research I went with a good quality system which my neighbour had installed. It was because of his experience and results with his system that I went with this supplier.

It is difficult to make comparisons when selecting a quote as there are many variables besides the price. While I had selected a different supplier initially, the specific installation requirements for my 2 storey house meant that there was a significant increase in the overall price for the same sytem, and that supplier didn't really have the equipment on hand to be able to carry out the installation easily. The supplier I chose did not add other than the standard 2-storey fee (which all companies seem to charge anyway).

I contacted several other suppliers who didn't even bother to reply including one who had previously done work for me as this is an enlargement and upgrade of a system installed 26 years ago, one of the first in Adelaide.

Adelaide Solar Systems impressed me from the outset by providing useful information on their website and by email. They then followed up with an on-site quote, including professional advice patterned to my situation. I am confident that they have helped me choose the most suitable system to meet my needs. As a bonus, their quote gave the best value for money since they deliver good quality panels and inverter.

Adelaide Solar Systems were one of 3 recommended companies provided by SolarQuotes.They provided a simple and competitive quote, and combined with a friends recommendation, we chose them to install our 4 kW system.Currently we are awaiting the scheduled installation of the system, so are unable to finalise our feedback of their product and service, however with many happy customer blogs on the net, no problems are anticipated.Thanks to Solar Quotes for their independant assistance / advise.
The supplier you suggested was the best choice for value and service for thesize of Solar system i needed.ThankyouNic M
I did not do enough homework, but the advice I got was pretty sound.

All 3 reps were very knowledgeable about the systems and answered any questions we asked. Did not feel rushed or pushed into making a purchase.The only issue is the time it will take before the system is installed due to the demand companies are currently experiencing.
Genrally the service provided was good except for one company which quoted without attending site, and was very slack in returning calls for quote.
The ;Solar Quotes service was very useful in highgrading the firms I used for quoting and in making as final decision as to which to use.

There were 2 mistakes with appointments for the quote with Adelaide Solar Systems, the first was their mistake, the 2nd was my mistake. However I am happy with the service so far. I'll let you know what the installation is like after it is done, in approximately 7 weeks. I did get other quotes from Origin, Mannix Solar and Modern Solar. I can only assume that Modern are trying to get rich very quickly, or they are praying on the gulible. Their quote after their ";discount" and allowing for the REC's was 3 times the price as the others ($18,900 for a 2 kw system. I was not interested in Origin or Mannix, as I don't see how they could give quotes without seeing the property.

I chased up on three quotes.  Adelaide Solar where successful because they sent out a tradesman to quote and not a salesperson on commission. Adelaide solar where the only one who actually climbed up on the roof and measured etc before they quoted. The quote was clear and concise with no sales pressure. They have not installed yet but will do so in a couple of weeks. Just after the quote my hot water service failed. I called Adelaide Solar and they had a temporary service in that same day and then installed a solar hot water system for me. It is gas boosted and the system is excellent. The service and install was of the highest quality and the pipework is a work of art. I hope the install of the soalr power system is as good.

We only had one quote come from your stystem but had 3 all togehter.  The information provided by you was extermely helpful in understanding the right questions to ask the sales people.  2 of our 3 quotes were for exatcly the same system and the company from your system could do it for the best price.

All questions regading the system were answered immediately, if not answered they informed me later of the information i requested of them. they also supplied a reference who i contacted regarding their satisfaction of the system and their dealings with the company. at this stage i am waiting for installation of the system which i was told would be a turn around time of 8-10weeks.very pleasant  and well informed representative. would not hesitate reccomending to others

So far so good. The 3kw system is going in in August.They were not the cheapest but were the only firm that gave clear product information and were prepared to tailor a system to meet our needs.  Eg They were able to source 300 watt panels which would fit the limited space on our north facing roof.They were the only firm that sent a sales person that really knew what he was talking about.

Company names are confusing and easy to mix up as most have "Solar" in the name.Very hard to separate the "overnight cowboys" from established businesses as the industry is new.Unless I can see the products on display as in a shop, I won't trust the company.Very hard to get to see previous work or speak to previous clients for feedback. Just getting a site inspection & quote was sometimes met with no response.I liked the level of detail and the various options in the Adelaide Solar Systems quote, as well as the technical responses to our questions. It was not the cheapest quote, but I feel confident in my choice of supplier.Finn Peacock from SolarQuotes.com.au sent some helpful info to make the decision process easier. Thanks......
The sales rep is aklso the project manager for installation. That was the determining factor - same person from signing to work completion.

The amount spent was the total cost of the system. We did benefit from the generous government rebate. Our outlay was just $2226 plus the $430 for a new meter.The guys at Adelaide Solar Systems were very professional and friendly.

The supplier I used was from your quotes, M Electrical; Security an Adelaide base company. The information I gained from your website was invaluable. I have recommend your website and M Electrical to other just recently.My solar unit was install in May 10, and I am looking forward to the benefits from the solar power.Thankyou for your help.

I ended up going back to Adelaide Solar Systems and showed cheaper quotes that we'd recieved for same size systems, but they were happy to drop their price to match. Wanted to go with ASS as salesperson was very helpful and explained everything really well.
we were unable to find a better deal , it cost us nothing and we were given a voucher of $1000 to spend at Coles Myer

I am extremely pleased with both the solar hot water and solar power, purchased and installed by Adelaide Solar Systems. Although a little disappointing with the time frame for installing the energy, I understood that it was out of their control, and it was worth the wait. I now eagerly await my electricity bill (Thats a first!!!) and as i keep a daily log on how much im putting back into the grid, can check that the HUGE amount off my bill is correct.!! I not only feel that im making money, Im also aware that im doing my little bit for the planet. We, as a family, have become more aware of the best times to use electricity,and more concious when we do; thus ensuring we maximise the amount going back into the grid. I LOVE IT!!!

Our consultant Marcus came at the promised time.We installed  Suntech Panels with a Sunny Boy SB2500 inverter.We signed the contract in late November 2009 and the system was installed in early January 2010. The new ETSA meter was installed 5 days later.We are more than happy with our installation. The system was not the cheapest, but we felt comfortable using Adelaide Solar.
I only had a solar hot water system installed but everything was done promptly, minimal interupption and excellent service.
Adelaide Solar Systems were fantastic from start to finish, everything went as planed,I would highly recommend them

They were very professional in all aspect, from returning calls, when they said they would arrived at my house for quoting on the day and time they said and supplied the written quote within 1 week.The installation started on the day they quoted and installation went as planned. All are completed within 1 day and no mess to clean up.I have no hesitation in recommending this company to all my friends. The result that I achieved from my solar system including solar hot water, is far better than expected.
it hasnt been installed yet so I cant give all ratings

As the system is yet to be installed some of the above does not applyI have been a Tradesman / Technician / accross three trades for a very long time; including many parallel  stints in supervision;It does not take long for someone with my back ground to pick people that are making recommendations based on sales jargon; wishful thinking; for me that does not sit wellThe people my wife and I picked in the end demonstrated integrity and at least a realistic understanding of electricity; if I have made a mistake; always possible; well then it is upon my head hoping that is not soRegards Geoff
Plenty of information for our situation from Solarhart and we are sure we have chosen the right unit.
